approved: Financial Services Compensation Scheme of Last Resort Levy (Collection) Bill 2021

The Financial Services Compensation Scheme of Last Resort Levy (Collection) Bill 2021 establishes a levy framework to fund the Compensation Scheme of Last Resort, comprising an annual levy collected from January 2023 and a one-off levy in 2022-23. It gives ASIC responsibility for issuing levy notices, collecting payments, seeking information, and imposing penalties for late payment or incorrect information.
